_comment: ML forecast model configuration. Read by predict_next.py at startup. evolve_model.py writes updated per_hospital_damping values here after each evolution run. Manual overrides in config/overrides.json take priority over everything in this file.
_section_forecast: Core projection parameters. horizon_min / cadence_min define the forecast window; momentum_damping is the global default dampening applied to linear extrapolation.
_section_confidence: Confidence score weights — must sum to 1.0.
_section_evolution: Safety constraints for evolve_model.py. Evolved damping values are clamped to [damping_min, damping_max]. Rows with error above anomaly_error_pct are excluded from training.
_section_per_hospital: Per-hospital damping factors written by evolve_model.py. Empty until enough forecast_audit.csv rows accumulate (min_rows_to_evolve per hospital). Values here override the global momentum_damping.
